title: A finite annihilator for a constructible torsion curve sheaf
statement: For a curve coefficient pair P over an algebraically closed field and a constructible underlying torsion abelian sheaf P.F, there is a natural number n > 0 such that n times the identity morphism of P.F is zero.

source.place: Definition 03RW and Lemma 095E; parent lem-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-sub-quotient proof step 1 (agent-written finite bound used in the reduction to Proposition 09BH (2))

proof.text: The curve is Noetherian since it is of finite type over a field. Every locally closed stratum of its finite constructible stratification is quasi-compact. The open images of a trivializing etale cover have a finite subcover; discard empty members. Constant underlying set sheaves have finite values because their geometric stalks are finite. Every stalk group on a selected member has order equal to the cardinality of that value. The factorial of that cardinality kills each such finite group. Multiply the finitely many positive factorials, taking 1 in the empty case.

Pullback identifies stratum stalks with the original stalks, so multiplication by this positive integer vanishes at every geometric stalk. Exactness implies that its image has zero stalks. Conservativity implies that image is zero, hence the multiplication morphism is zero.

proof_origin.place: Finite-bound argument of the parent node, from Definition 03RW and Lemma 095E
